prompts.prompt_preview: On a solid, medium-blue background, the text 'Lesson Recap' appears in the center of the screen in a bold, white, sans-serif font. Directly below it, a white checkmark icon inside a white circle appears. Both elements scale up into place and then remain static.

The 'Lesson Recap' title and checkmark icon slide off the top of the screen. From the left edge, a light-gray, rounded-corner card slides in, stopping in the left third of the screen. On this card, a dark gray icon of a hand pushing a box appears at the top. Below the icon, text appears line-by-line: first, 'Force (F)' in bold, dark gray; then, 'A push or pull.' in regular, dark gray; and finally, 'Unit: Newtons (N)' in regular, dark gray.

The 'Force' card remains on the left side of the screen. A second, identical light-gray card slides up from the bottom of the screen, stopping in the center, next to the 'Force' card. On this new card, a dark gray icon of a balance scale appears at the top. Below the icon, text appears line-by-line: 'Mass (m)' in bold, dark gray; then, 'Amount of matter.' in regular, dark gray; and finally, 'Unit: Kilograms (kg)' in regular, dark gray.

The 'Force' and 'Mass' cards remain on the left and center of the screen. A third, identical light-gray card slides in from the right edge, stopping in the right third of the screen. On this new card, a dark gray icon of a speedometer appears at the top. Below the icon, text appears line-by-line: 'Acceleration (a)' in bold, dark gray; then, 'Change in velocity.' in regular, dark gray; and finally, 'Unit: m/s²' in regular, dark gray. The three cards are now aligned horizontally across the screen.

The three cards simultaneously shrink and move to the top of the screen, aligning horizontally in the top quarter. From the small 'Force' card, a large, white, bold letter 'F' flies down and to the center-left. An equals sign '=' appears next to it. From the small 'Mass' card, a large, white, bold letter 'm' flies down to the right of the equals sign. The screen holds a static shot. At the top, the three small summary cards for Force, Mass, and Acceleration are aligned horizontally. In the center of the screen, the equation 'F = ma' is displayed in a large, bold, white font. The equation emits a soft, pulsing white glow for the entire duration.
